Test build adding History export and one template item per contact point.

Replaced by a newer release. It still unlocks and lets you move to the newer release, nothing more.

Changes

  • You can export your History from the vault (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.22.0).
  • Contact templates keep one item per contact point, without reserved tags (template registry version 2).
  • Built from vettid-vault commit 403d7d9 (tag release/staging/6) and independently rebuilt on 2026-10-09 with a matching PCR0.

Security

No security fix
